Create a Vibe Agent (a PHLO flow) via the LLM-driven vibe pipeline.

Three modes:
  Fresh interactive:  plivo agent create --prompt "a joke telling bot"
  Headless continue:  plivo agent create -c "approve and build it"
  Fast template copy: plivo agent create --from-template <existing_uuid>

The interactive flow shows the LLM's plan, asks you to approve/change/discard,
and (on approve) builds + saves the flow as a draft.

The -c flow is one-turn-per-invocation: session state is persisted to
~/.plivo/vibe-session.json so an AI driver can script multi-turn agent
creation as a sequence of one-shot commands. Use 'plivo agent session show'
to inspect the current session and 'plivo agent session clear' to reset.

Usage:
  plivo agent create [flags]

Flags:
  -c, --continue string        continue the saved vibe session with this follow-up message (one turn, non-interactive)
      --from string            E.164 caller-id (e.g. +14695184352) to fill into any outbound initiate_call nodes the LLM emits — required if the agent does outbound calls
      --from-template string   copy an existing agent uuid as the starting point (skips the LLM and lands a savable draft in one shot)
      --name string            agent name (override the LLM-suggested name)
      --prompt string          initial description (skips the interactive prompt)
      --session-id string      explicit session uuid to resume (default: read from ~/.plivo/vibe-session.json). Requires --continue.
      --type string            phlo_type: outgoing_call | incoming_call | outgoing_sms | incoming_sms | outgoing_whatsapp | incoming_whatsapp (default "outgoing_call")

Global Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts
